hero.description: Nox Communications is a PR agency built for founders who need coverage, credibility, and a voice — not just a press list.

services.title: What we do
services.note: Six disciplines, one point of view — your voice, sharpened for whoever needs to hear it next.

items.title: Editorial Features & Media Placements
items.description: We build relationships with the journalists and editors who cover your industry, then place your story with them — profiles, trend pieces, and features in the outlets your customers and investors actually read.

items.title: LinkedIn & Thought Leadership Strategy
items.description: A content strategy and posting cadence that turns your point of view into a recognisable presence — built to grow your reach and your reputation as an authority in your field, not just your follower count.

items.title: Founder Ghostwriting
items.description: Essays, posts, and talking points written in your voice, drawn out of you through structured interviews — so the ideas are yours, and the writing keeps up with them.

items.title: Press Releases
items.description: Announcements written to be picked up, not skimmed past — funding rounds, launches, and milestones drafted, timed, and distributed to land where they'll matter.

items.title: Social Media Marketing
items.description: Organic strategy and content across the platforms your audience actually uses — building a following and a voice that carries your PR wins further than a placement alone ever could.

items.title: Creative Founder PR
items.description: Campaigns and moments built around you, not a template — stunts, partnerships, and stories designed to make a founder memorable, not just mentioned.

philosophy.label: Our philosophy
philosophy.quote: Coverage fades. A reputation, built deliberately, compounds — that's the only kind of PR worth doing.

approach.title: Founder-first
approach.description: We work directly with founders, not just comms teams — because the story is usually theirs to tell.

approach.title: Earned, not bought
approach.description: Every placement is earned through relationships and relevance, never paid or sponsored coverage.

approach.title: Built to compound
approach.description: Each piece of coverage, post, and press release is chosen to build on the last, not stand alone.
